title: ReportFollowerConfigurationExt
description: Reports the follower configuration in response to a Query Follower Configuration message.

MessageID.comment: A two byte field to hold the message ID of a message

GroupID.comment: ID of the group. A value of zero (0) is not allowed.

Name.comment: An optional human readable name associated with this group

MaxSpeed.comment: Maximum speed the group is expected to achieve

VehicleID.comment: Subsystem ID of the follower being configured

LeaderErrorBehavior.comment: Error behavior desired for the leader. This value is expected to be passed to the leader via LeaderManagement::RegisterFollower

FollowerCompromised.comment: Error behavior desired for the leader. This value is expected to be passed to the leader via LeaderManagement::RegisterFollower

LostCommsFromFollower.comment: Error behavior desired for the leader. This value is expected to be passed to the leader via LeaderManagement::RegisterFollower

JausID.comment: JAUS ID of a Global Pose Sensor Service hosted on the leader

ComponentID.comment: JAUS ID of a Global Pose Sensor Service hosted on the leader

NodeID.comment: JAUS ID of a Global Pose Sensor Service hosted on the leader

SubsystemID.comment: JAUS ID of a Global Pose Sensor Service hosted on the leader

JausID.comment: JAUS ID of a Global Contact Sensor Service from which the ContactID was assigned

NodeID.comment: JAUS ID of a Global Contact Sensor Service from which the ContactID was assigned

SubsystemID.comment: JAUS ID of a Global Contact Sensor Service from which the ContactID was assigned

ContactID.comment: ID of the contact to be followed. A value of zero (0) is not allowed.

Empty.comment: The leader is not specified by a JAUS ID nor a Contact ID. The leader is assumed to be known a priori by the implementation

MinimumFollowTime.comment: Minimum time that the follower must maintain behind the leader or an error condition is triggered

MaximumFollowTime.comment: Maximum time that the follower must maintain behind the leader or an error condition is triggered

MinimumFollowDistance.comment: Minimum distance that the follower must maintain behind the leader or an error condition is triggered

MaximumFollowDistance.comment: Maximum distance that the follower must maintain behind the leader or an error condition is triggered

MaxCatchUpSpeed.comment: Maximum speed the follower is allowed to achieve to close a gap
